messages.content: Compile the CURRENT public rule task into declarative Python-syntax code, returned as {"code":STRING}. The code is parsed into a data-only source-linked DAG, never run as Python. Do not solve the task or emit a native answer beside the program. No tools or grading information are available. Use single-name assignments and a final query = EXPRESSION. No imports, attributes, loops, functions, comprehensions, arbitrary calls, mutation or reassignment. Internal names are unique ASCII identifiers of at most64 characters. A name has no implicit semantic meaning. Write named rule declarations before query; query cannot itself be a clause/observation/scope/residual declaration. Keep all parentheses balanced. Use Python True/False/None, not lowercase true/false/null. There are no contradiction(), entailment() or other answer functions; native labels are quoted strings selected by executable guarded rules. join_on takes TWO declared relations and a params dictionary; project_exists takes ONE relation. A quoted sN ID or empty string is never a graph input. Do not enumerate every sentence into bindings. Declare only literal inputs and required predicates, then write executable rule expressions and guarded clauses; reuse named definitions. Primitive inputs: name = TYPE(VALUE, sources=[UNIT_IDS]), with the nine actual typed shapes in language_contract. Every numeric value and public string must be grounded in those units. A relation contains actual factual witnesses, one cell per column, citing all required factual lines. Source IDs are provenance metadata, never relation cells or conclusions. Boolean primitive values require literal true/false in the cited text; paragraph numbers, years and 0/1 are not truth values. Factual predicates: b_name = observation(entity=QUOTE, entity_source=FACT_ID, predicate=QUOTE, predicate_source=RULE_ID). Both quotes must be exact source substrings; you do not provide their truth values in code. Reuse the same observation for identical quotes. Legal effects, thresholds, arithmetic, dates and comparisons belong in expressions, not observations. Missing legal/numeric subexpressions: b_name = residual(source=RULE_ID, quote=EXACT_SUBQUOTE). These retain both False/True and are never sent to the factual observer. A residual must be a proper subexpression actually read by its containing clause or scope. Never replace an entire untranslated rule, final claim or numerical comparison with a fact predicate or guessed Boolean. Local calculations: name = EXPRESSION. They do not discharge rule coverage. Scope declarations: name = scope(source=ONE_RULE_ID, condition=BOOLEAN_EXPRESSION). Only a nonconditional structural title may use literal True. Scope conditions are executable, not policy strings. All required_scope_sources must have scopes, including conditional prefaces. Rule outputs: name = clause(sources=[OWNED_RULE_IDS], value=EXPRESSION, otherwise=EXPRESSION). The engine physically guards each clause with all inherited scopes from the transitive source context. State the disabled value explicitly: False, 0, [], or None as appropriate. Do not guess it. Own only the rule units actually translated. A constant citation or unused scope does not cover a whole rule. Translate other supplied rules even if irrelevant to this query; leave genuinely untranslated units unowned so they retain unknown scope. Expressions: names, literal integers/strings/True/False/None, and/or/not, ==/!=/</<=, +/-, literal_integer * numeric_expression, numeric_expression / nonzero_literal_integer, (then_value if Boolean_condition else else_value), arrays [...], and dictionaries {string_key:expression}. Helper functions: add, sub, min, max, xor, eq, ne, lt, le, scale, divide_constant, ceil_divide_constant, number_at, array, pair, object, concat, all_of, any_of. They implement the same typed operations, not arbitrary Python; all branches must type check. all_of/any_of support an empty or single-element Boolean conjunction/disjunction. ceil_divide_constant(numeric, positive_literal_denominator) implements an increment or fraction thereof exactly; apply statutory bounds explicitly. Numeric vectors support vector[nonnegative_literal_index]; out-of-range access fails, with no default. A denominator 100 for percent or 2 for one-half is only the stated unit conversion, not a new factual amount. Connector assignments call the seven operators from language_contract with explicit params dictionaries. Projections are identity, amount_value, amount_values and entailment_label. Named results or nested calls are allowed. When an available learned graph matches actual slot and column obligations, invoke learned(pattern=HASH, variant=INDEX, slots={...}, columns={...}); copying its operators independently is not library use. Do not insert irrelevant calls to claim reuse. All consumption of one allowance bank must share one thread_allowance result; never clone or re-consume its bank. Read its different outputs from the one amount_values result. Each expression or graph has at most16 nested operators; factor longer ones into named nodes. The final query combines guarded CLAUSE outputs and public inputs into the native result in language_contract.query_result_schema; do not bypass guards via local helper/scope names. Do not return a constant native result. Source identifiers are not operands. Do not invent laws, witnesses, dates or constants. A quoted timing policy is not an executable date comparison; use supported numeric comparisons or preserve proper unknown subexpressions. accepted_program_code, when supplied, is the previously accepted translation; preserve unchanged primitive names and quotes to retain factual evidence. validation_feedback is source-only compiler diagnosis, never target answers; repair concrete errors without coercion or invented rules.  Compilation policy: answer_separating. Interface policy: collision_refined.
